note: The machine-readable form of spec/PROFILE-IMAGE.md section 6, and the profile-2 half of S-17 (ruled 2026-08-08). Nine conventions rather than profile 1's twenty-one, because an image has no handedness, no up axis and no quaternions, and declaring conventions a payload does not have would be exactly the advisory noise law 8 exists to remove. The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): a reader meeting this file must check THESE nine and must not report its own profile's conventions as missing.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary in an image package. WKEM is the only core one.

color_space_default.note: core.semantics through the palette. Only where the node does not declare its own color_space, which every conformant image node does.

pixel_origin.note: core.embedding because its descriptor indexes pixels; a descriptor computed from the other origin is a different vector wearing the same name.

alpha_mode.note: Only where has_alpha is true. A reader that does not support the declared alpha mode refuses those image nodes and still lists, hashes and extracts every byte.

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.
